frames.lost_estimate: gaps between rows at the nominal webcam fps

mapping.type: autoencoder (markerlessBoMI): 21 hand landmarks (x, y) -> 2 latent units -> cursor
mapping.customization: see setup.customization (steps, rot_deg, scale, flip_x, offset)

filter.applied: after the clip to the map space

config.sequence_rule: every outer region 12 times in seeded random order (seed 20): all 8 once before any repeat, never the same twice in a row; a home before each target and one after the last
config.first_target_rule: the session starts with the home (region 5); the first target appears when the cursor has stayed in the home for dwell_s
